changes: One shared operation-lifetime implementation replaces private admission lifetime logic and serves both loaders.
Runtime manifest/WASM fetch, read and hashing share a 60000 ms default deadline; caller option range 1..120000 ms. Admission retains its 30000 ms default.
Caller cancellation reaches fetch/read waits; late results cannot publish a verified app asset or start a stale activation.
Empty-model startup opens cache/catalog before any runtime download. Restore, P2P/companion install and Advanced local import obtain runtime bytes when required.
Activation reserves ownership before awaiting runtime bytes. Acquisition rechecks current qualification and exact runtime admission after waiting.
Current HTML shells bind 20 assets; serving/publication closure binds 31 artifacts including the shared helper.

observations.name: initial-focused-development-run
observations.reason: Two displayed boundary-test failures and async ReferenceError from missing injected ensureBrowserRuntimeAsset; outer 60000 ms harness timeout. No aggregate pass claim.
observations.nextAction: Updated production-section test dependencies, preserving their assertions.

observations.name: initial-chooser-development-run
observations.reason: Shared helper omitted from serving manifest, producing catalog-admission-loader-options before metadata fetching. At least ten displayed failures before the 120000 ms harness timeout. New fixture also lacked its explicit admission response.
observations.nextAction: Added helper to serving closure and explicit fixture admission route; reran against corrected source.

observations.name: final-focused
observations.scope: Lifetime, runtime loader including loopback HTTP and installed Edge minimal WASM, admission loader, app acquisition, ownership boundaries, P2P install, composition store and shells.

observations.name: final-artifact-publication
observations.scope: Seven artifact checks including two fresh offline builds; five static-server checks; fourteen publication/custody checks.

observations.name: final-chooser
observations.scope: Installed Edge desktop and emulated mobile viewports; empty page makes no runtime requests; manifest fetch timeout and Cancel recover without peer transfer; prior metadata deadline, altered receipt and duplicate-intent cases remain green.

coverage.appIntegration: Targeted production-function execution, source assertions and actual browser workflows; no whole-app percentage claimed.

limits: Synthetic fixture behavior is not real-model numerical, quality or useful inference evidence.
Mobile is Edge viewport emulation, not physical mobile hardware.
Deadlines bound asynchronous waiting, not synchronous CPU work or total model installation.
No model payload, source snapshot, cloud service, public seed, deployment or live MemoryEndpoints operation was produced.
Current source-authority scan still fails on the same two policy-blocked installer paths; no removal was retried.
Canonical seven repositories remain discovered; this checkpoint changes TinyRustLM only.

lesson.question: Can a bounded runtime body still stall setup or outlive its activation?
lesson.method: Deferred dependencies, cancellation races, actual served browser graph, publication closure and artifact reproduction.
lesson.result: Deferral and shared lifetime bound waiting while ownership checks reject stale completions.
lesson.uncertainty: No real default or public seed qualified.
lesson.decision: Keep preparation inside model operations and include helper in serving closure.
lesson.reusableLesson: Bound bytes, time and ownership independently; CommonJS success cannot prove browser script availability.
